rationale: The assistant correctly identified the blocked defrost drain, guided a safe cotton bud and warm water clear, and recommended no part or escalation, matching the ground truth. Weaknesses: the final message opens with a stray, out-of-context 'Before you start, switch it off and unplug it.' It also asked the same blocked/frozen/clear question twice, and never asked about the fridge still being cold or warned against sharp tools. Follow-up advice on prevention and fallback checks (drip tray, door seal) was sensible.
